content:
Hello Ishu don !!

(I have been wondering what name to give you but this is what I finally stick at)

If I have to pick one friend I absolutely admire, it has to be you.

Remember ..

The girl who loved her hair..

Who was stuck between NSIT IT and DTU IT..

Whose world was made of 2 colors  red and black..                                                                              (precisely the two colors a don turns anyone Who comes his way 😀 .. though that’s not the reason for your title)

If not ..its you dumbo-jumbo :D(Even this name sounds fun :D)

Remember,

first year when we together used to board our “DCE CALLEGE” plane to our famous Bawana-land… our Hogwarts.

That time we together explored our new home .. our college, the haunted lane, the sports complex, the lake..

That time we together hunted for new friends and finally ended up in an all gals gang :

**Me,you** ,
**Geetanjali** – the pretty London girl always high on demand,
**Smitaa** uff **P-Smitaa**..the sweetoo, the girl with a never ending supply of clothes..our in-house fashionista:p ,
**Shreya**– the genius.. still 80+

n ofc our **Komal-**Ms Pink: Softy (It took me a long time to guess the co-relation:komal=softy).. :p

Those times we used to sit in the ***OAT***, in*** Nesci***, in*** Mec-C*** copying assignments and enjoying our idyllic campus.

The Freshers and our*** first hostel trip***.. when we decorated ourselves in Geet’s room.

I still owe you for making my ***ED sheets,practical files*** and ofc the ***computer print outs***.

I know you did it because you liked writing, it has got nothing to do with me. :p

That time when we used to love Mec-C and ***chole bhature***– your staple food.

Those times when you rushed off home at*** dot 6*** leaving me to attend workshops all alone. That apart, leaving me all alone to find a gang to play with too.

Today, I will forgive you for that because you all together attended all classes for me only to later see my attendance being the highest of us all. 😀

(Thanks to the*** proxies*** :p, I cant help laughing at my 85% attendance in one class and all of your faces 😀 :D).

And yes, we used to make ***false calls*** to Yash to scare him, saying he was detained in Physics lab.

And also.. our *kurti days*.. :p

And how you guys freaked me out by telling couples’ stories and th

en made fun of me not able to understand your so called *high level talks*.

  😛

And then ended our first year with memories I ll always cherish ..

Now after first year I begin to lose track of years. Maybe facebook timeline would help. Remember the . Me, you, Smitaa, Yash, Ashish.. and how Yash

pulled out the OAT water hose to drench us all.. and that Uncle Vernon sized guard who asked for ID cards and how we all just ..

1..2..3.. run :D..:D

Our almost regular Metro Walk Mc- D trips and impromptu pic-clicks..We left no place to pose.. not even our college terrace..

And my birthday when we were all sitting in OAT, dogs came, Komal and Smitaa ran off.. you jumped dropping my lunch on my cargo, and I .. so worried about my new outfit shirked it off, unaware that it was falling on your so precious hair.. :D.. that day we just laughed our hearts out.

I also owe you one for introducing me to our Coding Blocks.

And remember.. when I had just started to write codes..and my codes refused to run..and I had no one to ask.. all I needed to do was to send them to you.. and you would sort everything out..
**And one ritual that has continued 😀**

Whenever I cannot contain my euphoria about something that happens to me ,I call you with night minutes..or I might as well exhaust my balance in a single call, thanks to my extra long tales.. to tell u everything to the minutest detail..and you have always been so nice that you listen to me as in its your story..**<touchwood>** *(Aaj kal ke selfish zamaane mein kiske paas tym h sunne ke liye kisi aur ki kahaaniyaan :p)*

*Together we have faced teachers worse off than Umbridge,*
*Together we have shared our deepest secrets..*
*AND*
*Together we have laughed our hearts out..*
*Together have we grown 4 big years..*
*Together we have overcame so many of our complexes and fears*
*Together we have shared the good and the bad times.. *
*and Together will we remain forever..come whatever may..*

You might be wondering why I chose to call you **Ishu don. **

You might love stuff I cannot keep up with .. for instance .. your favorite shopping.. :p

but you are one person time cannot alter,** you are veryyyy strong and virtuous .. stronger than you know or believe..**

Be it our different branches, our different immediate friend circles, the placement stress , or even the 2 extremities of personalities we posess..
**Nothing has been able to have its toll on you. In this day and age of an exceedingly pretentious world, you remain the very same innocent, and pure at heart girl whom I first met caught between DTU and NSIT, who is always there for everyone and who wishes the best for everyone..**

I love you My Ishu don ..
